title: Execution Intent Status
description: Operational status kept next to a signed Execution Intent. It is NOT part of what is signed, so it changes as the request progresses. PREPARED: the intent is signed and stored, and the action may or may not have been released. An intent that stays PREPARED needs reconciliation with the connector. RELEASED: the release stage returned and the execution context was saved, so the Trust Record can be rebuilt. FINALIZED: a signed Execution Trust Record exists for this transaction. ERRORED: the release stage raised an error. The action may still have been executed, so the outcome is unknown and must be reconciled. RESOLVED: a verified human reconciled a PREPARED or ERRORED intent at the connector and closed it with POST /execution-intents/{businessTransactionId}/resolve, recording what they found and a note. The resolution is an attributed operator statement stored in this unsigned status. It is NOT tamper evident and it is not a Trust Record.

releasedAt.description: When the release stage returned and the execution context was saved. Absent from PREPARED and from an ERRORED intent.

finalizedAt.description: When the intent was marked FINALIZED. Present only when state is FINALIZED.

finalizationMode.description: INLINE: the Trust Record was produced in the original request. REPAIRED: it was rebuilt afterwards by POST /execution-intents/{businessTransactionId}/finalize. Present only when state is FINALIZED.

trustRecordId.description: The Execution Trust Record for this transaction. Present only when state is FINALIZED.

failureReason.description: The error message the release stage raised. Present only when state is ERRORED.

resolution.description: What the operator found at the connector. Present only when state is RESOLVED.

resolutionNote.description: The operator's note. Required when resolving. Present only when state is RESOLVED.

resolvedBy.description: The authenticated caller who resolved it. Absent when caller authentication is disabled.

resolvedAt.description: When it was resolved. Present only when state is RESOLVED.
